context: Tests whether planning keeps a cohesive one-context change in one tracker item rather than manufacturing an epic or horizontal child tickets.

checklist.name: One issue
checklist.description: planning-result.md creates exactly one GitHub issue and no parent, epic, or child issue set

checklist.name: Outcome captured
checklist.description: The issue describes the configuration rename and one-release compatibility behavior

checklist.name: Acceptance criteria complete
checklist.description: Acceptance criteria cover the new key, old-key compatibility, deprecation warning, documentation update, and compatibility test

checklist.name: Verification captured
checklist.description: The issue includes verification expectations rather than only an implementation checklist

checklist.name: Repository metadata respected
checklist.description: The result applies or proposes the existing ready label only after the plan has complete acceptance and verification content

checklist.name: No layer tickets
checklist.description: The result does not split code, docs, and tests into separate tickets

checklist.name: No implementation
checklist.description: The response does not modify code or claim completion
